## Assignment Options

::: {.callout-note title="Mechanics Focus"}
This is a simplified equivalent-section strength problem. It evaluates static axial-plus-bending normal stress, transverse shear at its separate maximum location, first-yield factor of safety, and equivalent-diameter sizing. It is not a complete trailer-hitch design or certification analysis.
:::
